content.user_title: Validate ML Workflows for Hidden Antipatterns
content.value_statement: ML projects can look accurate while data leakage or weak evaluation hides serious flaws. This skill guides structured checks for splits, metrics, training, and deployment readiness.
actual_capabilities: Reviews ML plans for target leakage, temporal leakage, preprocessing leakage, and group leakage.
Checks evaluation methods for train/test contamination, metric mismatch, and repeated test-set use.
Provides deployment checklists for monitoring, drift detection, rollback, and graceful degradation.
Includes scripts for Python leakage scanning and CSV train/test split validation.
Guides metric selection for classification, regression, ranking, and time series work.
Highlights training pitfalls such as inference mode, class imbalance, and early stopping.
limitations: The scripts use heuristics and can miss complex multi-file ML pipelines.
It does not train, deploy, or benchmark models by itself.
It does not replace domain validation or statistical review.
CSV split validation needs user-supplied date, group, or target columns for deeper checks.

use_cases.title: Audit a New Training Plan
use_cases.description: Find leakage risks before a data scientist starts feature engineering or model training.

use_cases.title: Review Evaluation Results
use_cases.description: Check whether reported metrics use the right split, baseline, and business objective.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Model for Production
use_cases.description: Verify monitoring, drift checks, rollback plans, and fallback behavior before deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Check My ML Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my ML project plan for leakage and evaluation risks. Ask for missing split, target, metric, and deployment details.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Training Script
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this training workflow for preprocessing leakage, group leakage, class imbalance, and test-set misuse. Give prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Evaluation Methodology
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of reported model quality.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this model report for metric alignment, validation design, baseline comparison, confidence intervals, and repeated test-set use.

prompt_templates.title: Validate Deployment Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this deployment plan for monitoring, drift detection, feedback loops, graceful degradation, and rollback readiness.

output_examples.input: A churn model plan uses random splitting across customer events.
output: Flags possible group leakage because the same customer can appear in train and test data.
Recommends a group-aware split and a final held-out test set.
Suggests F1 or AUC-PR when churn labels are imbalanced.

output_examples.input: An image classifier report shows high accuracy after tuning on test data.
output: Marks the reported score as unreliable because the test set influenced model choices.
Recommends separate validation and final test sets.
Requests per-class metrics when class balance is unclear.

output_examples.input: A deployment plan only describes loading the model behind an endpoint.
output: Identifies missing monitoring for drift, latency, error rate, and prediction distribution.
Recommends a rollback plan with a saved previous model version.
Adds fallback behavior for invalid input and degraded service.

best_practices: Split train, validation, and test data before preprocessing, augmentation, or model selection.
Keep the final test set untouched until one final evaluation.
Choose metrics based on business cost, class balance, and prediction task.
anti_patterns: Fit preprocessors on all data before creating train and test splits.
Tune hyperparameters, thresholds, or features on the final test set.
Deploy models without drift monitoring, latency alerts, error tracking, or rollback plans.

faq.question: Does this skill run scripts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and local scripts that users can run intentionally.

faq.question: Can it detect data leakage?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers target, temporal, preprocessing, group, fold, and augmentation leakage patterns.

faq.question: Can it validate production readiness?
faq.answer: Yes. It checks monitoring, drift detection, rollback, fallback behavior, and retraining plans.

faq.question: Does it replace expert ML review?
faq.answer: No. It supports review but cannot replace domain knowledge, statistical judgment, or live experiments.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use ML plans, training scripts, evaluation reports, CSV split files, or deployment checklists.

faq.question: Which assistants can use it?
faq.answer: It is designed for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.
